description: SHYAM LOGISTIC (shyamlogistic) is a trusted logistics partner in Sangli, Maharashtra, offering reliable road transport across India. Book full truck load (FTL), part truck load (PTL), express cargo, and supply-chain support at www.shyamlogistic.online with transparent GST billing.
aboutText:
SHYAM LOGISTIC (shyamlogistic) was founded with a clear vision: make freight booking simple, transparent, and reliable for businesses and individuals across India. Founded by Mohanlal, we have built our reputation on dependable road logistics and customer-first service.

Whether you need industrial cargo, commercial goods, or time-critical consignments, every delivery is handled with care, accountability, and proper GST documentation.

We operate from our registered office in Shalini Nagar, Sangli, Maharashtra, and coordinate routes pan-India so your goods reach safely and on time. Visit www.shyamlogistic.online to get a free quote.
missionText: Our mission at SHYAM LOGISTIC is to provide seamless logistics solutions that help businesses grow—with speed, safety, and full transparency on every mile.
heroSubtext: Book freight with SHYAM LOGISTIC—seamless logistics connecting businesses nationwide. Professional handling, GST billing, and on-time road transport from Sangli to pan-India routes.

faqs.question: What services does SHYAM LOGISTIC offer?
faqs.answer: We offer full truck load (FTL), part truck load (PTL), express delivery, supply-chain solutions, warehousing support, and custom logistics for all types of goods booking.

faqs.question: Which areas do you cover?
faqs.answer: We coordinate pan-India road logistics from our registered office in Sangli, Maharashtra, covering major industrial and commercial routes.

faqs.question: How can I track my shipment?
faqs.answer: Call or message us on WhatsApp with your booking details. Our team will share the current transit status and expected delivery time.

faqs.question: What are your delivery timelines?
faqs.answer: Delivery times depend on route, cargo type, and vehicle. Share your origin and destination cities, and we will confirm an estimated transit time with your quote.

faqs.question: How can I get a quote for your services?
faqs.answer: Use the Get Quote form on this website or call 8459858242 / 9057420562. Share the cargo type, weight, and route for a clear estimate.
